# AOU Hub

> An unofficial companion app for students of the Arab Open University, Egypt.
> It signs in to the university's SIS and Moodle LMS with the student's own
> credentials, reads what they hold, and reports changes that neither system
> announces.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the Arab Open University.

## What it does

- One sign-in for two systems that share nothing, not even a password.
- Change detection across marks, exam schedule, timetable and fees. The app
  compares each fetch against the last one and reports the difference.
- A grade calculator that works in the university's own scheme: TMA out of 20,
  mid-term out of 30, final out of 50, pass at 60.
- Exam-day view with hall, seat and centre.
- Offline-first: the last successful fetch is readable with no connection.
- A study assistant answering questions about the student's own data.

## What it does not do

- It never sends SIS or LMS passwords to a server of its own or to Firebase.
  Credentials saved with the opt-in "Remember Me" stay in Android's encrypted
  storage on the device and are sent only to the university's own hosts.
- It shows no ads and does no ad tracking. A Google account is optional; the
  app works fully as a guest.
- It cannot register courses, pay fees, or write anything back to the
  university systems. Every request it makes is a read.

## Pages

- [English](https://ssssoliman937-design.github.io/aouapp/): product overview, screens, interactive demo, download.
- [Arabic](https://ssssoliman937-design.github.io/aouapp/ar/): the same page in Egyptian Arabic.

## Demo data

The interactive demo on the site uses invented data for a fictional student.
No real student record appears anywhere on this site.

## Platform

Android 7.0 or later. Distributed as a signed APK through GitHub Releases
(github.com/ssssoliman937-design/aouapp), linked from the site's download
section. There is no iOS version.
